MSTRecoveryPolicy.what: Turn on MST recovery for a device type and tune how it runs.
MSTRecoveryPolicy.ifAbsent: The device type is not recovered.

DeviceType.description: Device type to recover (one record per type).

RecoveryGroups.description: Devices recovered together. Default: derived from their I2C bus.

I2CForce.description: Force the I2C access. Default: only where a kernel driver owns the address.
